name: relay-workspace
description: Human and AI agent collaboration with a shared local workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w relay-core && npm run build -w relay-chat && npm run build -w relay-daemon && npm run build -w relay-supervisor && npm run build -w web && tsc -p packages/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run build && node --test dist/packages/relay-core/tests/*.test.js dist/packages/relay-chat/tests/*.test.js dist/packages/relay-daemon/tests/*.test.js dist/packages/relay-supervisor/tests/*.test.js dist/web/tests/*.test.js && npm run test:react -w web
scripts.test:py: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend --extra dev pytest
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend --extra dev pytest -m integration
